If I could score them - I would. This GP is honestly the absolutely worst surgery I’ve ever been with in my life. Not just are they extremely dismissive in regards to any issues raised to them, they make you feel a burden or rushed when seeking support especially within the mental health area, being from outside of the asian community and them being mainly an asian run surgery I’ve noticed the difference in treatment with different cultures and it’s absolutely disgusting to say the least the way I feel I’ve been treated here. During my pregnancy I was facing some issues which I seeked support from the surgery and I was appointed to see one of the midwife’s at the surgery I was very visibly upset and conveyed for my unborn baby’s safety to which I was told to go in a very cold manner  “go home and bleed out and if you then still need some help call back” so in no other words told to go home to potentially loose my baby and I asked if she could simply do a reassurance test with the hand held machine to just ensure baby’s heartbeat is at least stable but I was denied any suggestion I’d made. I was later prescribed with medication again during this same pregnancy which on the label clearly mentioned I shouldn’t have been taking during pregnancy so again MAJOR concern as this could have costed me my beautiful sons life. I’ve also had a few encounters where I’ve found the front of house staff very hostile, cold, unapproachable and just rude which makes things extremely difficult. I’ve since had few more issues happen which has made me finally leave. I only stayed with them this long as I was new to Birmingham after having just left London and where I live I’ve found it hard finding a GP as they all work with post codes over here and this was the only one available to me at the time.
